unexpressed.why: the borrowed words of DEF-NRS-484A-480-3 'visible from the front', which the record writes as a lit sig.warning_lamp facing front, cannot be stated: no atom form of the surface reads a warning lamp's facing (sig_warning_lamp takes a colour, or a colour and a mode, only; WarningLamp.facing is read by no accessor), so the rule can require a red flashing lamp but not one facing front, and would wrongly fire on a red flashing lamp facing only rear or side
